modelDescription: Whether you’re plinking at the range, hunting small game, shooting a competition, or just enjoying some time outdoors, the Modern Precision Rifle Rimfire is the ideal companion. We’re releasing Modern Precision Rifle Rimfire in 3 sought-after chamberings, including .17 HMR, .22 LR, and .22 WSM. Available in three distinct color combinations with three barrel lengths available for each caliber and two different handguard lengths, there’s truly an option for every shooter and application.
